candidates.description: This feature vector represents German modal and auxiliary verbs used to express necessity, possibility, or intention, along with common adversative conjunctions.
This vector represents common German auxiliary verbs, copulas, and grammatical function words.
This feature vector represents concepts related to artificial intelligence, cognitive organizations, and advanced learning systems.
This feature vector represents scientific or computational terminology related to research methods, testing, and problem-solving.
This feature vector activates on words, prefixes, and subwords related to complex systems, technology, and organizational structures.
This feature vector activates on tokens related to approximations, estimates, and variations in German and English.
This vector represents the concept of internal, fundamental, or formalized structural qualities and their binary opposites.
This vector represents common German action verbs in various tense and person forms.
This feature vector activates common German verbal stems and adjectives associated with academic, technical, or formal discourse.
This feature vector represents prefixes and roots of scientific, technical, and engineering disciplines.
